propositions: executor.py exceeds 790 LOC against an 800-LOC hard cap with only 10 lines headroom

the file contains two logically independent clusters: step-kind I/O contract model (declaration and static compatibility) and run engine (control flow, expression resolution, dispatch, recording) that share no call edges

step contract cluster functions (StepContract, STEP_CONTRACTS, contract_for, input_schema_for, shallow_contract_check and helpers) must be extracted to a new module while run engine functions (run_workflow, _dispatch, StepContext, StepResult, STEP_REGISTRY, RunState, RunResult) remain in executor.py
moved symbols must be re-exported from executor.py at module scope to preserve all existing import points unchanged and avoid breaking 50+ test modules that bind to module attributes
